name: v2.4.0
body:
Dabri can now run NVIDIA **Parakeet** TDT 0.6B v3 next to the Whisper models. 

It covers 25 European languages and **recognizes the spoken one on its own**, so you can switch between English and Spanish mid-dictation without touching settings; the language picker is greyed out while Parakeet is active. 

Hotkeys now fall back between evdev and D-Bus in both directions and show a notification when they fail to start. 

## What's Changed
* Refine/hotkey fallback by @AshBuk in https://github.com/AshBuk/dabri/pull/127
* STT: add NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 by @AshBuk in https://github.com/AshBuk/dabri/pull/129
* Refactor/stt package by @AshBuk in https://github.com/AshBuk/dabri/pull/130


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/AshBuk/dabri/compare/v2.3.0...v2.4.0

name: v2.3.0
body:
**PTT:** Hold the hotkey to record in the new push-to-talk mode, switchable from the tray or the main window.

**Whisper** now picks the best CPU variant at startup, so it runs on CPUs without AVX2 or FMA.

**Security:** WebSocket server requires an auth token for browser pages under a wildcard origin.

**AppImage** now carries update information, so AppImageUpdate or Gear Lever can update it in place and download only the changed parts.

 Under the hood, the services layer was refactored and the test suite refined.

## What's Changed
* appimage: embed update information and publish .zsync by @AshBuk in https://github.com/AshBuk/dabri/pull/117

* docs: sync architecture, test table and stats by @AshBuk in https://github.com/AshBuk/dabri/pull/119
* Refine/ws origin session race lint by @AshBuk in https://github.com/AshBuk/dabri/pull/120
* Refine/config race by @AshBuk in https://github.com/AshBuk/dabri/pull/121
* Drop the in-memory buffer mode and audio level callbacks by @AshBuk in https://github.com/AshBuk/dabri/pull/122
* Guard the outputter swap with the io mutex by @AshBuk in https://github.com/AshBuk/dabri/pull/123
* Perf/stop latency by @AshBuk in https://github.com/AshBuk/dabri/pull/124
* Style/doc comments by @AshBuk in https://github.com/AshBuk/dabri/pull/125

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/AshBuk/dabri/compare/v2.2.5...v2.3.0

name: v2.1.0
body:
## Dabri 2.1.0 — Sandbox-friendly & Flatpak

Dabri now runs fully sandboxed and ships also as a Flatpak.

Voice typing into the active window works inside the sandbox, and audio recording works out of the box. Global shortcuts and typing go through the standard Wayland desktop portals, powered by [go-wlportal](https://github.com/AshBuk/go-wlportal) — a small dedicated library — with an automatic clipboard fallback whenever a character can't be typed directly.

This release also adds an optional status window: a small window you can open from the tray and tuck back into it, with quick selectors for your settings.

## What's Changed
* Sandbox/troubleshooting by @AshBuk in https://github.com/AshBuk/dabri/pull/96
* UI/window by @AshBuk in https://github.com/AshBuk/dabri/pull/97

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/AshBuk/dabri/compare/v2.0.2...v2.1.0

name: v2.0.2
body:
## What's Changed
- **Fix** SIGILL crash at model load on CPUs without AVX-512 (AMD Zen 1, older Intel): whisper.cpp is now built with - GGML_NATIVE=OFF and GGML_AVX512=OFF, keeping a portable AVX/AVX2 baseline. (close #92, #95 )
- **Hotkeys:** the D-Bus GlobalShortcuts portal is now the default (evdev is opt-in).
- **whisper.cpp bump** → v1.8.6 (adds SPIRV-Headers as a Vulkan build dependency).

* Security/hotkeys least privilege by @AshBuk in https://github.com/AshBuk/dabri/pull/91

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/AshBuk/dabri/compare/v2.0.1...v2.0.2

name: v2.0.1
body:
## Major Update — Dabri v2

The project has been **renamed from speak-to-ai to Dabri** -  a unique name built for discoverability.

- **New branding** - fresh logo and identity across the app, desktop integration, and packages
- **Dynamic tray icons** - icon changes state during recording (default → red recording indicator)
- **New packages** — [AUR `dabri`](https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/dabri) · [COPR `ashbuk/dabri`](https://copr.fedorainfracloud.org/coprs/ashbuk/dabri/)
-  **Some minor refactors**
- migrate module path to github.com/AshBuk/dabri/v2

### ⚠️ Breaking changes — migration required

| What | Before | After |
|------|--------|-------|
| Binary | `speak-to-ai` | `dabri` |
| Config | `~/.config/speak-to-ai/` | `~/.config/dabri/` |
| Models | `~/.local/share/speak-to-ai/` | `~/.local/share/dabri/` |

If you have an existing Speak to AI installation, move your config and models:
```bash
mv ~/.config/speak-to-ai ~/.config/dabri
mv ~/.local/share/speak-to-ai ~/.local/share/dabri
```
* Rebrand/dabri by @AshBuk in https://github.com/AshBuk/speak-to-ai/pull/89

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/AshBuk/dabri/compare/v1.8.2...v2.0.1

name: v1.7.1
body:
### patch for 1.7.0
- **Tray sync on CLI model switch:** Tray menu now reflects model changes made via `speak-to-ai model set`

### Features
- **Whisper model management:** Choose between base, small, medium, and large-v3 quantized models — switch via system tray or CLI without restarting the daemon
- **Model hot-reload:** Seamless engine swap on model change — closes old engine, downloads if needed, creates new engine while mutex-protecting recording state
- **CLI model commands:** `model list` (offline), `model set <id>`, `model delete <id>` — manage models from terminal or scripts
- **Download cancellation:** Re-click a downloading model in tray to cancel; context-based cancellation propagates through the download pipeline
- **Tray model submenu:** Visual indicators for active model (●), available (○), downloading (⏳), and cancel-on-reclick (✖)

Based on #76 , #77

name: v1.4.2
body:
### Improvements
- **Concurrency cleanup:** Replace custom goroutine tracker with standard WaitGroup patterns ([#61](https://github.com/AshBuk/speak-to-ai/pull/61))
- **AppImage build refactoring:** Extract AppRun template, simplify build script (-62% lines) ([#62](https://github.com/AshBuk/speak-to-ai/pull/62))
- **Documentation:** Update supported distributions list for glibc 2.35+

### Context
Analyzed AppImage against @probonopd's (AppImage maintainer) "known-good" criteria 

| Criterion | Status | Decision |
|-----------|--------|----------|
|  Works without installing packages | ✅ Pass | Bundles 200+ libraries, works on standard desktop Linux |
| Works on old distros (Debian oldstable) | ⚠️ Partial | Requires glibc 2.35+ (Ubuntu 22.04+). Rejected Ubuntu 20.04 — missing ydotool |
| Self-contained (kernel only) | ❌ Skip | Not practical for GTK3 apps — would add 500MB+ and break theme integration |
| No unnecessary content | ✅ Fixed | Removed `/usr/share/doc` |

**Supported systems:**
- Ubuntu 22.04+ ✅
- Debian 12+ ✅
- Fedora 36+ ✅
- Linux Mint 21+, Pop!_OS 22.04+, Elementary OS 7+, Zorin OS 17+ ✅
- Arch Linux, Manjaro, EndeavourOS, openSUSE Tumbleweed ✅

---

- **Hotkey rebind optimization:** Reduced latency from ~1-2s to ~100ms ([#60](https://github.com/AshBuk/speak-to-ai/pull/60))
